caption: The drawing depicts a quilt pattern composed of a grid of squares arranged on the diagonal, forming an overall diamond-shaped layout. The main colors used in the drawing are blue, off-white, and a light pink or beige. Each square contains a geometric pattern: alternating between solid, lightly colored squares with a subtle quilted pattern and more complex squares with blue backgrounds and small white dots or floral motifs. The blue squares also contain triangular segments in off-white and pinkish shades, creating star-like or pinwheel designs within the squares. The overall composition alternates these patterned squares with the plain, off-white quilted squares. A thin border frames the composition, separating it from the cream-colored background. There is handwritten text and a signature in pencil beneath the drawing.
title: Padded Coverlet
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
